Class CocoClinicalTrialBaseService

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.connectors.Connector
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.connectors.ConnectorBase
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.opengovernance.GovernanceActionServiceConnector
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.opengovernance.GeneralGovernanceActionService
org.odpi.openmetadata.samples.governanceactions.clinicaltrials.CocoClinicalTrialBaseService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AuditLoggingComponent, SecureConnectorExtension, VirtualConnectorExtension, GovernanceActionService
Direct Known Subclasses:
CocoClinicalTrialCertifyHospitalService, CocoClinicalTrialHospitalOnboardingService, CocoClinicalTrialNominateHospitalService, CocoClinicalTrialSetUpDataLakeService, CocoClinicalTrialSetUpService
public class CocoClinicalTrialBaseService extends GeneralGovernanceActionService
Provides shared functions for the clinical trial services.

The services are written to be re-runnable: if a run fails part way through, or a clinical trial is set up a second time, each element and relationship that the earlier run created is found and reused rather than created again. Without this, the second run fails on the first element it tries to create, since its qualified name is already taken (OMAG-COMMON-409-001), and the elements the earlier run left behind have to be removed by hand before the service can be run again. The find-or-create methods below provide this behaviour.

    • getExistingTemplatedElementGUID

      protected String getExistingTemplatedElementGUID(String templateGUID, ElementProperties replacementProperties, Map<String,String> placeholderProperties) throws InvalidParameterException, PropertyServerException, UserNotAuthorizedException
      Return the unique identifier of the element that a template would create, if it already exists. The new element's qualified name comes from the replacement properties if they set one, and from the template otherwise, with the placeholders filled in the same way the template is copied. If a placeholder is left unfilled, the name cannot be predicted, and null is returned so that the element is created.
      Parameters:
      templateGUID - unique identifier of the template
      replacementProperties - properties that override the template's (may be null)
      placeholderProperties - placeholder values (may be null)
      Returns:
      unique identifier or null
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - invalid parameter
      PropertyServerException - problem accessing the metadata repository/server
      UserNotAuthorizedException - security problem

    • getExistingRelationshipGUID

      protected String getExistingRelationshipGUID(String relationshipTypeName, String end1GUID, String end2GUID, ElementProperties properties) throws InvalidParameterException, PropertyServerException, UserNotAuthorizedException
      Return the unique identifier of the relationship of this type from end1 to end2 whose properties include all the supplied string properties, or null if there is none. Matching on the properties as well as the ends keeps apart relationships that are legitimately repeated between the same two elements - an action target under two different names, a person assigned to a project in two roles, or lineage for two information supply chains.
      Parameters:
      relationshipTypeName - type of relationship
      end1GUID - unique identifier of the element at end 1
      end2GUID - unique identifier of the element at end 2
      properties - properties of the new relationship (may be null)
      Returns:
      unique identifier of the relationship or null
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - invalid parameter
      PropertyServerException - problem accessing the metadata repository/server
      UserNotAuthorizedException - security problem

    • createLineageRelationshipIfAbsent

      protected String createLineageRelationshipIfAbsent(String relationshipName, String sourceElementGUID, String iscQualifiedName, String label, String description, String formula, String formulaType, String queryId, String query, String guard, String lineNumber, String targetElementGUID) throws InvalidParameterException, PropertyServerException, UserNotAuthorizedException
      Create a lineage relationship unless an identical one is already in place. The parameters are those of GovernanceActionContext.createLineageRelationship.
      Parameters:
      relationshipName - either LineageMapping, ProcessCall, DataFlow, ControlFlow.
      sourceElementGUID - unique identifier of the element that describes the source of the data.
      iscQualifiedName - qualifiedName of the information supply chain
      label - label for when the lineage relationship is visualized
      description - description of the lineage relationship
      formula - expression summary
      formulaType - language used to express the formula
      queryId - identifier for the process query - DataMapping Relationship
      query - the process query - DataMapping Relationship
      guard - value that indicated a control path to take - ControlFlow relationship
      lineNumber - line number where the call is made - ProcessCall Relationship
      targetElementGUID - unique identifier of the element that describes the destination of the data.
      Returns:
      unique identifier of the new or existing relationship
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - invalid parameter
      PropertyServerException - problem accessing the metadata repository/server
      UserNotAuthorizedException - security problem
